# External source register

Record every external dataset used for the East Sikkim pilot here before preparation. Include:

- provider or institution;
- public URL or permission/reference identifier;
- licence or access permission;
- download/export date;
- geographic coverage;
- time coverage and timezone;
- columns used;
- known quality limitations.

Do not place credentials, API keys, private URLs, or restricted files in this repository. The preparation scripts do not fetch external data.
